result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that renders mostly well. Found a few minor layout and content issues related to text truncation and typo in placeholder text.

issues.description: The search field placeholder text reads 'Restarants, dishes, groceries' which contains a typo ('Restarants' should be 'Restaurants').
issues.suggestion: Correct the spelling to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' (Trattoria Piccol...) is cut off on the right edge, with truncated title text.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal carousel items are fully visible or add clearer visual affordance for scrolling; verify title truncation uses ellipsis intentionally.

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' pizza card at the bottom is partially cut off by the fixed bottom navigation bar, making it appear incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scroll area so content is not obscured by the navigation bar.

issues.description: The two heart/favorite icons have inconsistent styling: the ramen card heart is white outline on light background while the pizza card heart is white on dark circular background.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent favorite icon treatment across all cards for visual coherence.
